purpose: Credentialed end-to-end acceptance criteria for ChatGPT PR -> Jules verification -> merge gate -> local/ChatGPT handoff.

scenarios.setup: Create a PR from a same-repository chatgpt/<slug> branch with a behavioral requirement and at least one changed implementation file.
expected: router adds agent:chatgpt and jules:run
exactly one sticky Jules session is created
session prompt names the PR head SHA and requires behavioral plus adversarial evidence

scenarios.setup: Use an implementation that satisfies the stated behavior and has remotely runnable checks.
expected: Jules runs or adds focused behavioral tests
Jules performs at least one relevant red-team/adversarial probe
terminal agent message contains a valid certified verification marker
source PR receives jules:certified and has no agent:blocked/chatgpt:handoff labels
Jules certification workflow check succeeds

scenarios.setup: Seed a deterministic behavioral defect not caught by the original PR tests.
expected: Jules demonstrates the defect with a focused failing test or equivalent reproducible evidence
verdict is changes_required rather than certified
source PR receives jules:changes-required and agent:blocked
one deduplicated chatgpt:handoff issue is created
after the ChatGPT branch is repaired and synchronized, a new verification event can eventually certify the updated head

scenarios.setup: Use a case whose decisive evidence exists only on the Mac or in bounded local logs.
expected: Jules returns needs_evidence with exact bounded requests instead of waiting indefinitely
one chatgpt:handoff issue records the requests without secrets/private payloads
local consumer first runs fleet sync --only owner/repo
local consumer reads current AGENTS.md and synchronizes project Instructions through chatgpt-opencli before handoff when that capability is enabled
known canonical ChatGPT conversation is continued when provenance exists; otherwise a fresh project-scoped handoff is used
collected evidence or repair is returned to the source PR and Jules can resume
required_evidence: ChatGPT conversation URL or explicit fresh-handoff record

scenarios.setup: Present a genuinely material product/security/data-loss choice with no safe inferred answer.
expected: router permits one autonomous unblock nudge before surfacing the question
Jules remains sticky to the same account/session
source PR receives jules:needs-user and agent:blocked
handoff issue contains the exact material question
no automatic merge or owner transfer occurs

scenarios.setup: Replay identical GitHub events, retry after label failure, and re-run handoff creation.
expected: no duplicate Jules session is created
no duplicate handoff issue is created
signed router state remains bound to repository, issue, comment and sticky owner
uncertain external sends are not blindly replayed

scenarios.setup: Change applicable AGENTS.md after an earlier ChatGPT project handoff, then trigger a new local handoff.
expected: chatgpt-opencli detects current applicable AGENTS.md
project Instructions are synchronized before the new prompt is submitted
handoff provenance may record an AGENTS content hash but never copies private instruction text into GitHub
ChatGPT response follows the updated instruction contract
